title: Positive-Bound Nondeterministic Time Hierarchy
statement: Let $f,g:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ be time-constructible functions: each $T\in\{f,g\}$ satisfies $n\le T(n)$ for every $n$, and some positive constant $c$ and finite deterministic Turing machine compute the binary expansion of $T(|x|)$ on every input $x$ within $c(T(|x|)+1)$ steps. Suppose $g(n)>0$ for every $n$, and for every natural number $A$ there is an $N$ such that, for all $n\ge N$, $A\bigl(f(n+1)+f(n)+n+1\bigr)\le g(n)$. Then $\mathrm{NTIME}(f)$ is a proper subset of $\mathrm{NTIME}(g)$.
